initialization: z_0 = Phase I pass-only sensor mean
limitations: P3-001 found no sensor significant at FDR < 0.05, so the 10 selected sensors are exploratory candidates, not confirmed root causes. Limits and rules were not tuned against Phase II fail labels; Phase II stays out-of-sample. MR-based sigma assumes short-term stability of Phase I.
methodology: EWMA z_t = lambda*x_t + (1-lambda)*z_{t-1} with z_0 = Phase I pass-only mean; mu/sigma are Phase I only. Limits use the time-varying startup variance sigma*sqrt(lambda/(2-lambda)*(1-(1-lambda)^(2t))) with width L. State advances per valid Phase II observation only (missing values skipped, identities preserved, no imputation). Overlap counts are descriptive lot-level coincidences with WE violations, not quality metrics.
